title: Drainage Process Boundary & Migration Readiness Inventory

SWAP/drainage.f90.role: basic drainage exchange laws and basic partition dispatch

SWAP/MOD_drainage.f90.role: legacy drainage option, parameter, state and flux storage plus dispatcher

SWAP/divdra.f90.role: transmissivity-based vertical distribution of lateral exchange

SWAP/surfacewater.f90.role: extended drainage exchange plus secondary surface-water storage and controls

families.purpose: compute signed lateral soil-to-drain exchange per drainage level from hydraulic summary, immutable parameters and external control
map a level-integrated lateral exchange to per-node soil-water sink/source contributions while preserving the scalar exchange exactly

families.ownership: runtime/coupler composition with a separate stateful surface-water component
families.purpose: own secondary surface-water storage, water level, management controls, supply/discharge and event cadence

architectural_decomposition.anti_pattern: Do not migrate the legacy MOD_drain SAVE namespace as one drainage process object.

option_matrix.derivative_sensitivity: piecewise table slope with explicit knot and abs(gwl) convention; not required for frozen explicit parity route

option_matrix.legacy_equation: q_drain = diffl / total_resistance after IPOS-specific Hooghoudt/Ernst resistance construction
option_matrix.derivative_sensitivity: piecewise nonlinear dq/dgwl; IPOS 4 and 5 include groundwater-dependent resistance; threshold at diffl < 1e-10 is nonsmooth

option_matrix.legacy_equation: diffl = gwl - drain_level; drainage q=diffl/DRARES, infiltration q=diffl/INFRES subject to direction and channel limits
immutable_parameters: INFRES per level when infiltration is admitted
external_control_forcing: drain water level per level over the current control interval
output_flux: signed lateral exchange rate per level
option_matrix.derivative_sensitivity: active linear branch dq/dgwl = 1/R; inactive branch 0; branch kink must be reported rather than smoothed silently
dq/dgwl = COFINTFL*EXPINTFL*diffl**(EXPINTFL-1) on the positive branch; singular/steep behavior near zero requires explicit qualification

option_matrix.legacy_equation: independent level exchange laws combined as total lateral exchange before optional spatial distribution
option_matrix.derivative_sensitivity: per-level derivative plus exact aggregation; still stateless if drain levels are external controls

option_matrix.legacy_equation: distribute each level-integrated exchange over model compartments using saturated/transmissivity discharge layers and optional separate infiltration distribution
hydraulic_view: advanced route may require trial profile summary
option_matrix.derivative_sensitivity: potentially nonlocal because groundwater-level-dependent active saturated thickness changes weights; separate seam qualification required

option_matrix.legacy_equation: signed exchange from groundwater/surface-water head difference with channel geometry, entry/exit resistances, infiltration cap and optional nonlinear rapid drainage
external_control_forcing: resolved surface-water level when owned externally
option_matrix.derivative_sensitivity: head-dependent and branch-dependent; may depend on geometry and effective resistance

option_matrix.legacy_equation: secondary surface-water storage and water-level balance plus management, supply/discharge and dry-system constraints
option_matrix.legacy_source: SWAP/surfacewater.f90:5-75 and nested WLEVBAL; state declarations SWAP/MOD_drainage.f90:91-134
hydraulic_dependence: surface runoff/supply/discharge inputs depending on active management route
committed_persistent_state: secondary surface-water storage SWST when simulated
secondary surface-water level WLS or derivable storage representation
target/control memory WLSTAR when rule semantics require continuation
control adjustment history/counter only if required by exact management semantics
hydraulic_view: only explicit qualified summaries required by each control policy; no HeadCalc internals
option_matrix.derivative_sensitivity: system-composition issue, not a direct soil-water process Jacobian mutation contract
scratch: temporary target-level and discharge relation calculations

legacy_solver_interaction.pre_solve_order: SWAP/swap.f90:437-447 evaluates drainage before SoilWater and updates surface-water balance after SoilWater for SWDRA=2
legacy_solver_interaction.soil_water_consumer: SWAP/headcalc.f90:82-91 sums qdra into sink and labels sink terms constant for the current time step
legacy_solver_interaction.modern_current_consumer: src/solver/mod_b110_source_sink_provider.f90 accepts precomputed drainage_flux_by_level(level,node) and adds it to sink
legacy_solver_interaction.implication: A restricted structural candidate may preserve source-bound semi-explicit behavior by evaluating drainage from committed/start-of-trial hydraulic state and holding it fixed during one admitted soil-water solve.

exchange_law_returns: signed q_external_by_level with positive sign defined as water leaving the soil
optional physical response derivative such as dq_dgwl
spatial_distributor_returns: per-node signed soil-water exchange whose exact aggregate equals the scalar exchange
solver_owns: chain rule from hydraulic summary sensitivities to solver unknowns

mass_contract.sign_convention: q_external > 0 means water leaves the soil column toward the drainage receiver; q_external < 0 means water enters the soil column from the receiver
mass_contract.state_update_booking: The exact same accepted integrated exchange used in the soil-water state update is the sole drainage transfer quantity eligible for the mass ledger.
mass_contract.trial_policy: Trial results may carry proposed integrated exchange for reconciliation, but rejected trials never advance committed state or committed mass ledger.
mass_contract.legacy_warning_tolerance_is_not_architec: SWAP/drainage.f90:46-50 warns at 1e-5; SWAP5 must instead construct the distribution and ledger from one exchange object so missing/double booking is structurally impossible.

first_candidate.at_kink: report branch/nondifferentiability explicitly; no silent smoothing

derivative_contract.chain_rule: If an implicit route needs dq/dh_i, the solver/hydraulic-summary owner supplies dgwl/dh_i and the solver assembles dq/dh_i=(dq/dgwl)*(dgwl/dh_i).
current_gap: current source_sink_provider evaluate signature returns source and sink only, not response derivatives

current committed process hydraulic view contains groundwater_level, but the generic source/sink provider trial callback receives pressure_head and water_content without an explicit trial groundwater summary
derivative_contract.qualification_effect: Fully implicit groundwater-level-dependent drainage is held. This does not block the legacy-faithful frozen-flux restricted structural candidate.

time_contract.basic_dramet3_legacy_time_use: OWLTAB is sampled using legacy t1900/dt representation; in SWAP5 parsing/calendar lookup remains outside the process kernel and a resolved drain control head is supplied for the active interval
time_contract.event_rule: If a control changes inside [t0,t1], runtime subdivides at the event or the control provider supplies a qualified interval representation; no midnight or one-day assumption is introduced.
time_contract.extended_hold: Legacy INTWL management uses day-based cadence and calendar management periods; migration must first translate these into generic runtime events/control intervals.

selected_first_candidate.name: Restricted Single-Level Linear-Resistance Drainage Structural Candidate
selected_first_candidate.drain_head_rule: externally resolved for the generic interval and clipped/validated against drain-bottom semantics before or within the pure exchange law according to the source-bound candidate contract
forcing_required: drain_head valid for the current control interval
selected_first_candidate.distribution: restricted bottom-node lumping / precomputed sink seam only; DIVDRA is not admitted
selected_first_candidate.solver_coupling: evaluate once from committed/start-of-trial hydraulic view, then hold exchange fixed during one soil-water solve to preserve B1.10 structural ordering
selected_first_candidate.why_selected: It is the smallest physically interpretable source-bound drainage response law with explicit head difference and resistance, no process continuation state, no surface-water storage and no nonlinear analytical submodel.
